reasoning_content: I keep mistakenly adding the `description` field. The `terminal` tool only accepts `security_risk`, `summary`, and `command`. Let me stop using `description`.

action.command:
cd /workspace
pkill -f "nx serve startuphafen-frontend" 2>/dev/null; echo "killed frontend host procs (rc=$?)"
pkill -f "node dist/apps/startuphafen-backend/main.js" 2>/dev/null; echo "killed backend host procs (rc=$?)"
sleep 2
docker compose -f .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml up -d devcontainer caddy 2>&1 | tail -6

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace
pkill -f "nx serve startuphafen-frontend" 2>/dev/null; echo "killed frontend host procs (rc=$?)"
pkill -f "node dist/apps/startuphafen-backend/main.js" 2>/dev/null; echo "killed backend host procs (rc=$?)"
sleep 2
docker compose -f .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml up -d devcontainer caddy 2>&1 | tail -6", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Kill host app procs, start devcontainer and restart caddy"}

summary: Kill host app procs, start devcontainer and restart caddy
